title: Define a minimum viable starting package and progressive pathway
requirements:
- Integrate REDDHI, interoperability, SGI, SMART Guidelines, epidemiological intelligence and AI maturity into one framework
- Elaborate a practical phased approach for countries with fragmented legacy systems and limited capacity
- Define or cross-reference the 'REDDHI minimum viable layer' at first use
- Describe starting with bounded use cases, defined participants and explicit legal authority
- Define staged conformance levels from published specifications and basic validation up to certification and continuous assurance
- Identify foundational versus advanced components and readiness criteria between stages
- Describe a minimum starting package and concrete phase outputs for low-capacity settings
- Specify baseline security and audit controls where PKI and gateways are not yet available
